name: Clipper
description: Works through video from X or your own uploads, decides where the funny beat is, and cuts short clips and captioned talking GIFs around it, then files the results. Best when the footage has a punchline to find rather than information to summarise.

official.title: Clipper by X
official.description: Turns videos from X or your files into short clips and GIFs with a clear angle. Watches the footage, picks the joke, captions talking GIFs, files them...
